label: Whatever has its being caused is in act as to being
paraphrase: Open premise, analyst formulation, unattributed. For all c and x: if c causes x's being (CausesIn c x esse), then x is in act as to being (InAct x esse). The weak version, restricted to esse, of STMT-CAUSED-PERFECTION-IS-HAD-BY-EFFECT (a caused perfection, in any respect, is had by its effect), which strengthens it (verified projection). It says that an effect of a cause of being has the being caused in it; it says nothing about how long, whether the cause sustains it, or whether the cause is distinct from x.
